OER Headlamp Switch Mounting Nut 1968 Chevy Nova and 1968-1989 Corvette

Reproduction of the nut used to secure the headlamp switch to the dash on 1968 Chevy II Nova and 1968-1989 Corvette models. Manufactured as original with the correct thread and slotted head design with an insulated inner guide as original.

Applications

1968 Chevrolet Chevy II Nova

1968-1989 Chevrolet Corvette
